personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Structure) + warm Headspace-like colors + MasterClass layout
personality_one_liner: A welcoming, premium, Apple-quality content hub that uses warm tans, golds, and deep purple to educate older adults on retirement.

spacing.rule: Ensure ample breathing room and hitSlop for accessibility. 48pt minimum touch target size. Avoid dense dashboard grids.

do_s: Use on bottom tab bar for native feel
Use on sticky header backgrounds over scrolling content
Use on hero cards with a photo background
dont_s: Do not use on body text regions
Do not use if it compromises accessibility/contrast for older users

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A curated, Apple News-style personalized feed presenting multiple content rails.

states.loading: Centered spinner or skeleton loader for rails.
states.empty: Illustration with 'No new content yet' and a CTA to 'Explore Library'.
states.error: Error message indicating failed feed load with 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with multiple horizontal carousels (rails). Use a large, immersive hero tile for 'Featured Book' or 'Today\'s Tip' with a gradient scrim and text overlay. Subsequent rails ('Continue Reading', 'Latest Articles') use smaller, cleanly spaced cards with warm white backgrounds against the cream surface. Header is sticky with glassmorphism.

screens.name: Learn
screens.purpose: Category browser styled like MasterClass library for discovering specialized topics.
screens.layout: Tabbed or pill-filtered content-type differentiation model. Use large immersive tiles for primary topics (e.g., Retirement Planning, Taxes) and compact tiles for sub-topics. Focus on strong hierarchy, minimal text, and high-quality imagery.

screens.name: ArticleReader
screens.purpose: Distraction-free reading experience prioritizing accessibility and legibility.
screens.layout: Editorial-style vertical scroll. Massive, high-contrast title, large body copy (17pt+), generous line-height (1.5x). Prominent contextual actions at the top or bottom for Bookmarking and Sharing. Include a 'Reading Time' meta tag.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User management, bookmarks, and the primary lead-generation CTA.
screens.layout: List-based settings interface. Top section prominently features the 'Talk to an advisor' Calendly CTA card, styled as a premium banner (using the Deep Purple/Gold gradient background) to make it stand out elegantly without feeling intrusive. Below are standard list rows for Bookmarks, Downloads, and Reading History.

instructions_to_main_agent: ACCESSIBILITY IS CRITICAL: Ensure all typography uses the specified scale (minimum base 17pt) and all touch targets are at least 48x48pt.
Use the Deep Purple color (#4B3166) strictly for depth elements (headers, gradients, key CTAs like the Calendly lead gen) and never as a primary background for standard content.
Implement the 'gradient scrim' pattern for any text overlaid on images (e.g., Hero cards, Featured Books) to ensure WCAG AA contrast compliance.
Maintain the 'MasterClass' / 'Apple News' visual hierarchy: prioritize clean, large typography, immersive hero tiles, and multiple curated horizontal rails on the Home screen.
Ensure 'Talk to an advisor' feels premium and native (using the abstract purple/gold texture as a background for its card), avoiding an intrusive 'ad' feel.
Include high contrast on the Gold (#C5A059) accents by pairing them carefully with Charcoal Text (#231F20).
